paper.title_en: Metallogenic quantum criticality: Fermi surface nucleation at transitions between gapped phases
paper.abstract_en: Continuous quantum phase transitions in interacting many-body systems exhibit universal phenomena that are largely independent of microscopic details. An organizing principle distilled from canonical examples such as the magnetic transition in Ising models is that the low-energy physics of transitions between gapped phases is governed by scale-invariant quantum field theories with gapless degrees of freedom at isolated points in momentum space. In this paper, we show that this principle can fail in a radical way: an entire gapless Fermi surface can emerge at a quantum critical point separating two fully gapped insulators. These exotic phase transitions are dubbed \textit{metallogenic quantum critical points} (MGQCP). We construct a controlled family of effective field theories for MGQCPs between distinct fractional Chern insulators and propose a periodically modulated quantum Hall bilayer as a minimal microscopic setting. The critical theory exhibits an unusual mixture of physical signatures: while transport and compressibility follow scaling laws compatible with a conformal field theory, the electron spectral function develops a power-law non-analyticity at the Fermi momentum, characteristic of non-Fermi-liquid metals. We discuss how the concept of MGQCP may shed new light on critical phenomena in moire materials with tunable Chern bands. More generally, our results point to a broader class of quantum critical phenomena in which extended manifolds of gapless excitations emerge in momentum space despite being absent in both neighboring phases.

decision.selection_reason_zh: 提出了全新的量子临界现象——金属生成量子临界点，具有理论深度和新颖性，适合领域专家进一步阅读。
decision.title_zh: 金属生成量子临界：能隙相之间跃迁时的费米面成核
decision.abstract_zh: 相互作用多体系统中的连续量子相变表现出普遍现象，这些现象在很大程度上与微观细节无关。从诸如伊辛模型中磁性转变等典型例子中提炼出的一个组织原则是，能隙相之间跃迁的低能物理由具有标度不变的量子场论控制，这些理论在动量空间的孤立点处具有无能隙自由度。在本文中，我们表明这一原则可能以一种根本性的方式失效：一个完整的无能隙费米面可以在一个量子临界点处出现，该点分隔两个完全能隙化的绝缘体。这些奇异的相变被称为“金属生成量子临界点”（MGQCP）。我们为不同分数量子霍尔绝缘体之间的MGQCP构建了一个受控的有效场论族，并提出一个周期性调制的量子霍尔双层作为最小微观背景。临界理论表现出不寻常的物理特征混合：虽然输运和压缩率遵循与共形场论兼容的标度律，但电子谱函数在费米动量处出现幂律非解析性，这是非费米液体金属的特征。我们讨论了MGQCP的概念如何为具有可调陈带的摩尔材料中的临界现象提供新的见解。更一般地，我们的结果指向一类更广泛的量子临界现象，在这些现象中，动量空间中扩展的无能隙激发流形出现，尽管在相邻两相中均不存在。
